slides.title: Before your next appointment in Portugal
slides.subtitle: A quick checklist to reduce avoidable delays

slides.title: Check these first
items: Confirm the correct office and appointment time.
Bring valid identification and requested originals.
Keep digital and paper copies of key documents.

slides.title: Ready before you leave
slides.body: Recheck the official instructions because document requirements may vary by service.
slides.cta: Save this checklist for appointment day
